name: Curiosity
description: Eight open prompts about what you learned and what you wonder, with optional notes that stay on this device.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight open prompts about learning and wondering, shown on Reflection Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Follow whichever question catches your interest.
howToPlay: Read the prompt and see where your mind goes.
If you like, type a few words in the notes box. They stay on this device.
Press Next for another prompt, or Back to return.
tips: A note can be a single word. Clear your notes any time.
